name: std::basic_ofstream<CharT,Traits>::is_open
intro:
Checks if the file stream has an associated file.

Effectively calls rdbuf()->is_open().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the file stream has an associated file, false otherwise.

summary: Checks if the file stream has an associated file.
